args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. Per runbook, performed an emergency rollback in all production regions to the most recent release that was healthy in production: v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy across all regions on v2.3.0 with error rate down to 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging but v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so re-deploying v2.3.1 will require change-manager approval and a fix for the underlying issue.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
